items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You've heard Johnny Hodges play soprano. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes, Johnny does. He's old, he's fast, he's green light on soprano.

ctx.x: I thought he went with a listener on his clarinet but I thought, I'm not sure. But he set a good style for clarinet oh years ago. A good style for clarinet. And I don't know, maybe he saw so many clarinet players come along and he said, I'll take this soprano. And he took it and made God rich of it. But I had a lot of soprano saxophone. I just don't like to tell them what they had. Well of course I'm me about what does me, what I like or dislike. But Bache did some with it all right. But Charlotte Bonnet and a…
You've heard Johnny Hodges play soprano.
Oh yes, Johnny does. He's old, he's fast, he's green light on soprano. Those three to me played in tune. But to me, Bache did ever play in tune. Maybe that's what took the people. You see them?
